summary: Comprehensive testing of GGS (Game Gear Swap) marketplace after major UI updates. All 34 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirms all requested features are working: Header shows 'Game Gear Swap' full name (no search bar), Footer has 8 social links, Post Ad is single page with ₹10 payment modal, hierarchical Kerala location (District→Taluk→Area), Product detail has Ad ID with copy button, Report modal, Safety tips, OpenStreetMap, Seller profile link. Dashboard has Mark as Sold, Profile editing with phone OTP, Avatar upload, Apply for Verification.

frontend: Homepage loads with 'Game Gear Swap' full name in header
No search bar in header navigation
Footer has all 8 social links (Discord, X, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, Reddit, Email)
Login page with email/password form
Login flow works correctly
Post Ad page is single page form (no stepper)
Post Ad has all sections: Basic Details, Product Details, Images, Location, Contact
Post Ad has hierarchical location: District, Sub-District (Taluk), Village/Town/Municipality
Post Ad shows ₹10 listing fee notice
Post Ad has 'Continue to Payment (₹10)' button
Product detail shows Ad ID with copy button
Product detail has Report button
Product detail Report modal opens with reason dropdown
Product detail has Safety tips section ('Your safety matters to us!')
Product detail has OpenStreetMap embed with 'View larger map' link
Product detail has Seller profile link
Dashboard Listings tab with Mark as Sold button
Dashboard Profile tab with avatar upload
Dashboard Profile tab with phone Change button
Dashboard shows Verified Seller badge for verified users

critical_code_review_comments: ₹10 payment model correctly implemented - listings start as 'pending_payment' and become 'active' after payment
Hierarchical Kerala location data properly structured in keralaLocations.js
All 8 social media links present in footer with proper data-testid attributes
Google Auth, Mobile OTP, and Razorpay Payment are MOCKED - not production-ready
seed_data_creation: Database seeded with admin user, test user, 6 categories with subcategories, and sample listings

All backend APIs working. Google Auth, Mobile OTP, and Razorpay Payment are MOCKED.
